name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text:
Parliament is asking for a larger EU budget for 2028–2034: 1.27% of the EU's national income, plus 0.11% set aside to repay joint borrowing. It rejects the Commission's smaller plan and wants the money not frozen in real terms. It also wants separate, protected funds for farming, fisheries, regions and social projects, and more money for research, transport and energy links, Erasmus+ and civil protection.

- Bigger budget: 1.27% of national income, plus 0.11% to repay joint borrowing.
- Separate protected funds for farming, fisheries, regions and social projects.
- More for research, transport and energy links, Erasmus+ and civil protection.
